gaps.sentence: City rents are crippling. In the countryside, ___, property is far cheaper.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' moves to a contrasting (not opposite) situation.

gaps.sentence: I'll tell you everything ___ you promise to keep it between us.
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' sets the condition attached to the promise.

gaps.sentence: The essay was submitted late and, ___, it ignored the brief entirely.
gaps.explanation: 'What is more' adds a further, stronger point to an already negative picture.
'Due to personal reasons' is the standard collocation for giving a cause.

gaps.sentence: In Sweden the shops close early, ___ in Spain they stay open until ten.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' contrasts parallel facts about two countries.

gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.

gaps.sentence: Take a jumper ___ the evening turns cold.
gaps.explanation: 'In case' = as a precaution against possibility.

gaps.sentence: ___ his salary, he earns royalties from three textbooks.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition to + noun' adds one source of income to another.
